verify-delivery-change: Is this checkout ready to ship? Check the candidate and its reported build result.
Identifies the revision mismatch in build.txt, runs the local test, reports the failing total, and leaves the candidate untouched.
autonomous-software-delivery: Take the incorrect multiple-unit total from investigation through a verified local patch. Leave enough evidence for a fresh session to pick it up.

Fixes the actual price calculation, runs the regression test, reports the verified local endpoint and records evidence. For a resume trial interrupt after the edit, start a fresh session and ask it to finish from the checkpoint.
release-delivery-change: Monitor the simulated staging rollout described in rollout.md. You may roll back locally if its health threshold is breached. Verify the result.
Uses the recorded failure threshold, restores the previous version in deployed.txt, runs the runbook health command and reports operation, version and observed health.
setup-delivery-repository: Make this repository straightforward for a new contributor to bootstrap and verify from a clean checkout.

Provides a runnable local verification command and documents prerequisites. Keeps changes scoped to local setup and leaves hosted workflows and product behavior untouched. Try the command from a clean copy and confirm it exposes the existing pricing failure.
setup-continuous-delivery: Design merge checks and artifact promotion for this example service. Give me a plan only. Staging and production must run the same tested artifact.
Connects merge checks to the candidate revision, promotes one immutable artifact, and specifies runtime verification and recovery.
review-architecture-boundaries: Trace how orders and billing depend on each other. Identify a concrete ownership violation and its impact.
Traces checkout.py through orders.py to billing.py and identifies direct mutation of the billing ledger, with file evidence.
design-modular-monolith: Design module APIs and data ownership for orders and billing. Our two engineers release both together and need atomic checkout.

Specifies who owns the ledger, the API orders calls, the commit point, rollback after a failure between writes, and a check that detects new cross-module access. Fail a design that claims atomicity while a pending order or charge can survive a failed checkout.
verify-django-migrations: The order reference change passed CI on a new database. Check whether an upgrade will work for existing orders and fix any issues you find. The release is unpublished.

Reproduces the populated upgrade failure from orders.0001_initial, repairs the migration sequence, and verifies a populated upgrade and a clean install. Independently seed at least two distinct order numbers, including one with leading zeros. Check the original rows and order numbers survive, each reference is exactly ORD- followed by the original order number, and the database rejects null and duplicate references. Review the trace or a regression check for evidence of the populated upgrade.
diagnose-django-performance: Diagnose why the two order formset scenarios in scenarios.py slow down as row count increases. Measure each before recommending changes.

Measures both factories. Shows 18 extra queries for repeated and zero extra queries for bulky, measures response byte growth, and ties each remedy to the measured cause. Equivalent instrumentation earns full credit.
